messages:
Ravi: heads-up — starting a quick smoke bring-up for the new embeddings candidate 'bingo-v1' in staging. goal: quick recall@k, cluster sanity, and a short int8 vs fp16 check. running minimal eval set now.
Clara: nice — which datasets?
Ravi: wiki-snippets + internal faq subset (2k queries) and a small multi-lingual holdout (~500).
Jae: FYI I already did a micro-quant run on a laptop: int8 symmetric per-tensor. cosine shift mean ~0.011, std 0.006.
Maya: can you share the command you used?
Jae: `python eval.py --model bingo-v1 --datasets wiki,faq --quant=int8 --metrics recall@1,5,10,cosine_shift --save=out/bingo-int8.json`
Ravi: thanks. I'll run the official harness on staging GPUs with the same config.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: bingo-v1 -> staging-pool-3 (10% traffic). :rocket:
Sam: tagging observability: put a span on tokenization + kvcache hits. want kvcache traces for embed generation.
Pierre: quick request — include the 'search-short' promptset too (short queries tend to amplify recall drops).
Clara: early numbers from Jae's micro-run pasted below:
```
Recall@1: fp16=0.663, int8=0.645  (-0.018)
Recall@5: fp16=0.811, int8=0.803  (-0.008)
Cosine mean shift: 0.011
Cluster purity (kmeans 100): fp16=0.74, int8=0.72
```
Maya: not terrible, but that -1.8% @1 could be visible in UX. how does this compare to our onboard baseline (opal-v2)?
Jae: baseline opal-v2 fp16 Recall@1 = 0.659 on same seed. bingo-v1 fp16 is slightly better (0.663).
Ravi: good signal. main concern is any systematic short-query failures. please run short queries (<=8 tokens) stratified check.
Clara: ran short-query slice on staging canary — quick paste: Recall@1 (short): fp16=0.61, int8=0.58 (-0.03). embedding distances compressed for ~12% of examples.
Sam: ops: can we pin a fallback route? if canary recall drops >2% on short queries, route to opal-v2.
ops-bot: Fallback policy attached to canary: rollback-to=opal-v2 if short_recall_delta > 0.02 within 30m.
Pierre: UMAP plots uploaded to the run artifacts: looks like a few small clusters merged near origin for int8. I'll attach screenshots in a follow-up.
Maya: suggestion: try per-channel quant (int8-perchannel) and also reduce clipping threshold. those usually preserve local neighborhoods.
Jae: will run int8-perchannel tomorrow morning. estimate 2-3 hours for full harness.
Ravi: action items: 1) Jae run int8-perchannel + clipping sweep, 2) Clara run stratified short-query holdout with search-short promptset, 3) Pierre add cluster purity metrics (silhouette, entropy) to the dashboard, 4) Sam observe canary for 60m and enforce fallback.
Clara: logging note — saw occasional NaN in normalized vectors for ~6 examples during preprocessing; opened ticket ML-4632.
Sam: rolling observability alert for NaN during preprocessing turned on.
Ravi: thanks all. if int8-perchannel brings Recall@1 delta to <1% and short-query delta <1.5% we can promote to canary 50%. otherwise hold. ping me once Jae finishes. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Canary health check: 10% traffic, 0 errors, 14% CPU, 22% GPU utilization. next check in 10m.
Pierre: attached quick notes in the eval run with thumbnails and sample nearest-neighbors that failed.
Jae: starting per-channel sweep now: jobs queued (staging-gpu-a, staging-gpu-b). will post results.
Ravi: perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Clara: +1 — tagging @product-research to keep them posted on short-query UX risk. :eyes:
